P0 · WIP — Auto routing across validated AI connection profiles

Extend beyond current Standard/Analysis slots: optional encrypted profiles for Bedrock Claude/GPT, Gemini Vertex, OpenCode-backed models and eligible ChatGPT/Codex connections. Tools/clients are not themselves distinct models; avoid duplicate routes to the same backend. Separate Intel-approved and personal data permissions; never transfer protected evidence to an unapproved account. Select one eligible model per request using task type, context/vision/tool capabilities, verified access, health and explicit cost ceilings. Provide manual override, selection explanation and approved fallback; no silent expensive escalation or concurrent multi-model billing. Validate candidate invocation separately from catalog presence, preserve credential removal/revocation and fail closed when no permitted profile exists. Acceptance: provider/profile isolation, no secret exposure, revoked/expired access, deterministic routing contracts, benchmark quality and live access checks. Dependencies: multi-provider profile storage/settings and permission labels; current Auto only chooses the active provider Standard/Analysis models. Remark: new routing feature; not implemented yet.
User decision: Auto policy must be user-selectable (Balanced, Quality, Economy), alongside manual selection. First policy-selector batch is being verified within the current provider; encrypted multi-provider pool and permission/cost/health routing remain open.

P0 · Done — Clarify unclear requests before fetching information

VVIP user requirement. If the prompt is unclear or partly clear and current chat context cannot resolve the missing target, scope or desired outcome, ask the user before any external source fetch or action preparation. Use one short question with yes/no, single-choice, multiple-choice or free-text input as appropriate. Offer relevant alternatives without guessing. Preserve the original prompt/draft; continue only after the required answer. Clear greetings and context-resolved follow-ups should not trigger unnecessary questions. Acceptance: native and Responses providers, manual/Auto modes, context follow-ups, no GitHub/Jira/Jenkins/web reads before required clarification, resumed context, revoked access and concise accessible question UI.
